solve' ls = go [] [(0, 0)] $ zip [0..] ls
  where
    go :: [Int] -> [(Int, Int)] -> [(Int, Char)] -> [Int]
    go _ ponds [] = tail . reverse . map snd $ ponds
    go [] ponds ((i, l):ls)
      | l == '\\' = go [i] ponds ls
      | otherwise = go [] ponds ls
    go stk ponds ((i, l):ls)
      | l == '\\' = go (i:stk) ponds ls
      | l == '_' = go stk ponds ls
      | l == '/' = go tailStk newPonds ls
      where
        (s:tailStk) = stk
        ((x, prevArea):tailPonds) = ponds
        areaIncrement = i - s
        newPonds = unitePonds (s, areaIncrement) ponds

unitePonds :: (Int, Int) -> [(Int, Int)] -> [(Int, Int)]
unitePonds (x, ax) ponds@((y, ay):tailPonds) = 
  if x < y 
  then unitePonds (x, ax + ay) tailPonds
  else (x, ax):ponds

solve :: [(Int, Slope)] -> [Int]
solve = iter [] [] where
    iter _ lakes [] = map snd (reverse lakes)
    iter [] lakes ((_, Rising):ls) = iter [] lakes ls -- skip
    iter indexes lakes ((_, Flat):ls) = iter indexes lakes ls -- skip
    iter indexes lakes ((j, GoingDown):ls) = iter (j:indexes) lakes ls
    iter (i:indexes) lakes ((j, Rising):ls) = iter indexes (updateLakes i j lakes) ls

    updateLakes i j [] = [(i, j-i)]
    updateLakes i j lakes = (i, j-i + sumArea):others where
        (toUnite, others) = span (\(k, _) -> i < k) lakes
        sumArea = sum (map snd toUnite)

data Slope = Rising | Flat | GoingDown deriving (Eq, Show)

toList :: B.ByteString -> [(Int, Slope)]
toList = iter 0 where
    iter i s = if B.null s
                    then []
                    else (case B.head s of
                            '/'  -> (i,  Rising)
                            '_'  -> (i,  Flat)
                            '\\' -> (i,  GoingDown)):iter (i+1) (B.tail s)

import Data.List

type Area = (Int, Int)
type Diagram = [(Int, Char)]

toDiagram :: String -> Diagram
toDiagram = zip [1..]

calcAreas :: Diagram -> Diagram -> [(Area, Int)] -> [(Area, Int)]
calcAreas [] _ zs = zs
calcAreas ((i, c):xs) ys zs
  | c == '_'  = calcAreas xs ys zs
  | c == '\\' = calcAreas xs ((i, c):ys) zs
  | c == '/'  = let prevD = find (\y -> snd y == '\\') ys
                in case prevD of
                  Nothing -> calcAreas xs ys zs
                  Just d -> calcAreas xs (delete d ys) (addArea i d zs)

addArea :: Int -> (Int, Char) -> [(Area, Int)] -> [(Area, Int)]
addArea nEnd (nStart, c) xs = ((nStart, nEnd), nEnd - nStart):xs

summarizeAreas :: [(Area, Int)] -> [(Area, Int)]
summarizeAreas [] = []
summarizeAreas [x] = [x]
summarizeAreas (((s1, e1), v1):((s2, e2), v2):xs)
  | s1 < s2 && e1 > e2 = summarizeAreas (((s1, e1), v1 + v2):xs)
  | otherwise          = ((s1, e1), v1) : summarizeAreas (((s2, e2), v2):xs)

main = do
  input <- getLine
  let result = reverse $ map snd $
                 summarizeAreas $ calcAreas (toDiagram input) [] []
  print $ sum result
  putStrLn $ unwords $ map show ((length result):result)

        bs    = map fst . filter (\c -> snd c == '/' ) $ cs

    print $ sum areas
    putStr . show $ length areas
    when (areas /= []) $ putStr " "
    putStrLn $ unwords . map show . reverse $ areas


solve :: [Int] -> [Int] -> [(Int, Int)] -> [Int]
solve as []     areas = map snd areas
solve as (b:bs) areas =
    case getDown as b of
        Nothing ->
            solve as  bs areas
        Just a  ->
            solve as' bs (step areas')
          where
            as'    = [ x | x <- as, a /= x ]
            areas' = (a, b - a) : areas


getDown :: [Int] -> Int -> Maybe Int
getDown as b =
    case takeWhile (<b) as of
        [] ->
            Nothing
        cs ->
            Just (last cs)


step :: [(Int, Int)] -> [(Int, Int)]
step areas@((x, xa):(y, ya):rest)
    | y < x     = areas
    | otherwise = step $ (x, xa + ya) : rest
step areas = areas

solve :: [(Int, Char)]
      -> [(Int, Int)]
      -> [(Int, Char)]
      -> [Int]
solve _ ps [] = fmap snd (reverse ps)
solve ds ps (x@(n, '\\'):xs) = solve (x : ds) ps xs
solve [] ps (x@(n, '/'):xs) = solve [] ps xs
solve ((m, _):ds) ps (x@(n, '/'):xs) = solve ds (newp : pr) xs
  where
    (pl, pr) = span ((>= m) . fst) ps
    newp = (n, (n - m) + sum (fmap snd pl))
solve ds ps (x:xs) = solve ds ps xs

def calc_area a
  l = a.length
  t = a[0]
  ls = Array.new
  s = 0
  for i in 1...l
    if a[i-1] == a[i]
      s += (t - a[i]) * 2
    elsif a[i-1] < a[i]
      s += (t - a[i]) * 2 + 1
    else
      s += (t - a[i]) * 2 - 1
    end
    if a[i] == t && s != 0
      ls.push(s/2)
      s = 0
    end
  end
  ls
end

def split_map a
  n = a.length
  t = a.max
  l = a.index(t)
  r = a.rindex(t)
  area = []
  if l == r
    if l == 0
      l = a.index(a[n-1])
      area.concat(calc_area a[l,n-l])
    elsif r == n-1
      r = a.rindex(a[0])
      area.concat(calc_area a[0,r+1])
    else
      area.concat(split_map a[0,l]) if l > 0
      area.concat(split_map a[r+1,n-r]) if r < n-1
    end
  else
    area.concat(split_map a[0,l]) if l > 0
    area.concat(calc_area a[l,r-l+1])
    area.concat(split_map a[r+1,n-r]) if r < n-1
  end
  area
end

def additable_flood?(after_sections, dup)
  sim_dup = 0
  after_sections.size.times do |i|
    case after_sections[i]
    when '\\'
      sim_dup -= 1
    when '/'
      sim_dup += 1
      return false if sim_dup > 0
    end
  end

  true
end

    dup += 1

      area += step - ds
      dup -= 1

      if dup != 0 && additable_flood?(sections[i+1..-1], dup)

        area = 0
        down_step = []
        step = 0
        next
      end
    end
  end

  if (dup == 0 && area != 0)
    floods << area
    area = 0
    down_step = []
    step = 0
  end
end

class MyStack
  def initialize(max)
    @top = 0
    @max = max
    @s = Array.new(max)
  end

  def is_empty?
    @top == 0
  end

  def is_full?
    @top >= (@max -1)
  end

  def push(x)
    if is_full?
      raise "overflow"
    end
    @top += 1
    @s[@top] = x
  end

  def pop
    if is_empty?
      raise "underflow"
    end
    @top -=1
    @s[@top+1]
  end

  def dump
    puts @s
  end

  def print
    results = []
    while (!is_empty?) do
      results << pop[1]
    end
    pools = results.empty? ? '' : ' ' + results.reverse.join(' ')
    puts results.length.to_s + pools
  end
end

def main(input = input = STDIN.gets)
  input.chomp!

  y = 0
  stack = []

  input.chars.each_with_index do |ch, x|
    # puts "#{ch} (#{x}, #{y})"

    case ch
    when '\\' # DOWN
      y -= 1
      stack << [x, y]
    when '/'  # UP
      area = 0

      until stack.empty? || stack.all?{|e| e.is_a?(Integer)}
        case stack[-1]
        when Integer
          area += stack.pop
        when Array
          last_x, _ = stack.pop
          area += x - last_x
          break
        end
      end
      stack << area unless area.zero?

      y += 1
    when '_'
      # skip
    end
  end

  areas = stack.select{|e| e.is_a?(Integer) }

  puts areas.sum
  puts [areas.length, *areas].join ' '
end

class Ground
  def initialize(ground)
    @str_ground = ground # ["/","/", "\"]
    @int_ground = to_i_array # [1, 2, 1]
  end

  def to_i_array
    h = 0
    @str_ground.map do |g|
      if g == "/"
        h += 1
      elsif g == "_"
        h
      elsif g == "\\"
        h -= 1
      end
    end.unshift(0)
  end

  def puddles
    peak_index = @int_ground.index(@int_ground.max)
    left_puddles = UpSlope.new(@int_ground[0..peak_index]).find_puddles
    right_puddles = DownSlope.new(@int_ground[peak_index..-1]).find_puddles

    left_puddles + right_puddles
  end
end

class DownSlope
  def initialize(int_ground)
    @upslope = UpSlope.new(int_ground.reverse)
  end

  def find_puddles
    @upslope.find_puddles.reverse
  end
end

class UpSlope
  def initialize(int_ground)
    @points = int_ground
  end

  def find_puddles
    puddles = []
    start = 0
    @points.each_with_index do |g, i|
      if i == 0
        # スキップ
        next
      elsif start != (i - 1) # startが固定されてる
        if @points[start] == g  # 終わり
          puddles << Puddle.new(@points[start..i])
          start = i
        end
      elsif @points[i-1] <= g  # 上りか平面
        start = i
      else # 初めて下りになった時
        # startを固定する
      end
    end
    puddles    # [Puddle(...), Puddle(..)]
  end
end

class Puddle
  attr_accessor :size

  def initialize(ground)
    @ground = ground
    @size = calculate_size
  end

  private

  # 真ん中でならす
  def calculate_size
    max = @ground.max
    max * @ground.size - @ground.sum
  end
end

def calc_area a
  l = a.length
  t = a[0]
  ls = Array.new
  s = 0
  for i in 1...l
    if a[i-1] == a[i]
      s += (t - a[i]) * 2
    elsif a[i-1] < a[i]
      s += (t - a[i]) * 2 + 1
    else
      s += (t - a[i]) * 2 - 1
    end
    if a[i] == t && s != 0
      ls.push(s/2)
      s = 0
    end
  end
  ls
end

def split_map a
  n = a.length
  t = a.max
  b = a.min
  l = a.index(t)
  r = a.rindex(t)
  area = []
  if l == r && (l == 0 || r == n-1)
    while (t >= b) && ((l = a.index(t)) == (r = a.rindex(t)))
      t -= 1
    end
    return area if t < b
  end
  area.concat(split_map a[0,l]) if l > 0
  area.concat(calc_area a[l,r-l+1]) if l != r
  area.concat(split_map a[r+1,n-r]) if r < n-1
  area
end

    end

  each_area << [sum, new_area[1]]
end

diagram = gets.chomp.chars

upper_skip = ->{
  loop do
    a = diagram[0]
    break if a == "\\"
    diagram.shift
  end
}

downer_skip = ->(target_depth) {
  depth = 0
  index = 0
  until depth == target_depth
    depth -= 1 if diagram.shift == "\\"
    index += 1
  end
  index
}

highest = ->{
  max_index = height = 0
  max_height = -Float::INFINITY 
  0.upto(diagram.size - 1) do |j|
    case diagram[j]
    when "\\"
      height -= 1
    when "/"
      height += 1
      max_height, max_index = height, j if max_height < height
      return [0, j] if height.zero?
    end
  end
  [max_height, max_index]
}

calc = ->(from, to) {
  depth = area = 0
  from.upto(to) do
    case diagram.shift
    when "\\"
      area += depth + 1/2r
      depth += 1
    when "_"
      area += depth
    when "/"
      depth -= 1
      area += depth + 1/2r
    end
  end
  area.to_i
}

pools = []
loop do
  upper_skip.()
  height, index = highest.()
  if height.zero?
    pools << calc.(0, index)
  elsif height == -Float::INFINITY
    break
  else
    first_index = downer_skip.(height)
    pools << calc.(first_index, index)
  end
  break if diagram.size.zero?
end

def solve(diagram)
  area = 0
  froms = []
  layers = []
  (0...diagram.size).each do |x|
    c = diagram[x]
    case c
    when '\\' then
      froms.push x
    when '/' then
      next if froms.empty?
      from = froms.pop
      area += 1
      area += x - from - 1
      layers << [from, x]
    end
  end
  return area, layers
end

let analysis (area:string) =
  let len = String.length area in
  let stack = Stack.create () in
  let rec loop acc = function
      i when i = len -> acc
    | i ->
      match area.[i] with
      | '\\' -> Stack.push i stack; loop acc (i+1)
      | '/' -> loop
                 (match Stack.length stack with
                    0 -> acc
                  | _ -> let j = Stack.pop stack in
                    (((j,i),i-j)::acc))
                 (i+1)
      | _ -> loop acc (i+1)
  in loop [] 0

let summarize lst =
  let rec loop acc = function
      []  -> acc
    | [x] -> x::acc
    | ((s1,e1),v1)::((s2,e2),v2)::r when s1 < s2 && e1 > e2 ->
      loop acc (((s1,e1), v1+v2)::r)
    | a::(b::r as rest) -> loop (a::acc) rest
  in loop [] lst

let calc_area lst =
  let rec doit (i, idxs, acc) = function
    | '_' -> (i + 1, idxs, acc)
    | '\\' -> (i + 1, i :: idxs, acc)
    | '_' -> begin
        match idxs with
        | [] -> (i + 1, idxs, acc)
        | j :: js -> (i + 1, js, ((j, i), i - j) :: acc)
      end
    | _ -> exit 1
  in
  let (_, _, acc) = List.fold_left doit (0, [], []) lst in
  acc

        if j1 < j2 && i1 > i2 then doit acc (((j1, i1), area1 + area2) :: tl)
        else doit (xs :: acc) ys
  in
  doit [] lst

        pond = i - j

class S2:
    # 池の位置と大きさのリスト
    def __init__(self):
        self.point = []
        self.size = []

    def append(self, x, y):
        lake_size = y
        if not self.point:  # 一番最初の池の処理
            self.point.append(x)
            self.size.append(lake_size)
        else:
            if self.point[-1] < x:
                self.point.append(x)
                self.size.append(lake_size)
            else:
                while self.point[-1] > x:
                    # print('w self.point:{} x:{}'.format(self.point[-1], x))
                    self.point.pop()
                    lake_size += self.size[-1]
                    self.size.pop()
                    if not self.point:
                        break
                self.point.append(x)
                self.size.append(lake_size)
        # print('append point:{} append size:{}'.format(self.point, self.size))
        return self

    def pop(self):
        x = self.point.pop()
        y = self.size.pop()
        return x, y

    def sum_size(self):
        sum_size = sum(self.size)
        return sum_size

class Stack():
    def __init__(self):
        self.top=0
        self.top2=0
        self.S=[None]*1000
        self.S2= [None] * 1000
        self.total=0
        self.count=0
        self.haihun=0
        self.arealist=[]
        self.N=0
        self.part=0
        self.compt=False
        self.calc_flag=False
        self.up=0
    def isEmpty(self):
        return self.top==0
    def push(self,fig,finish=0):

        if fig=='\\':
            self.count += 1
            self.S.insert(self.top,self.count)
            self.top += 1


        elif fig=='/':
            self.count += 1
            it=self.pop()
            if self.top > 0: self.top -= 1#0=空

            if it is not None:

                # self.total = self.count - it + self.total  # 合計を図る
                self.S2.insert(self.top2, ([self.count - it, it]))
                self.top2+=1

                while(True):
                    if self.S2[self.top2 - 2] is None:break
                    if self.S2[self.top2-2][1]> it:#中に囲まれている
                        i=self.pop2()
                        if self.top2 > 0: self.top2 -= 1  # 0=空
                        j = self.pop2()
                        if self.top2> 0: self.top2 -= 1  # 0=空
                        self.S2.insert(self.top2,([i[0]+j[0],i[1]]))
                        self.top2 += 1
                    else:break
                if self.pop(flag=1) is None:  # 次がないとき
                    self.N += 1  # 池の数
                    while (True):
                        vari = self.pop2(flag=1)
                        if vari is not None:
                            if it <= vari[1]:
                                self.total += vari[0]
                            else:
                                break
                            self.pop2()
                            if self.top2 > 0: self.top2 -= 1  # 0=空
                        else:
                            break
                    self.part = self.total - self.part
                    self.arealist.append(self.part)
                    self.part = self.total


        elif fig=='_':
            self.count+=1
        if finish==1:
            if self.pop(flag=1) is not  None:  # 途中で終わってしまった
                rest=[]
                while(True):
                    part=self.popup()
                    self.up+=1
                    self.top2-=1
                    if  part is not None:
                        self.arealist.append(part[0])
                        self.N += 1  # 池の数
                        self.total+=part[0]
                    else:break





    def pop(self,flag=0):
        vari=self.S[self.top-1]
        if flag==0:
          self.S[self.top-1]=None
        return vari
    def pop2(self,flag=0):
        vari=self.S2[self.top2-1]
        if flag==0:
          self.S2[self.top2-1]=None
        return vari
    def popup(self):
        vari = self.S2[self.up]
        return vari
    def print(self):#終了
        self.push(None,finish=1)
        self.arealist=self.arealist[::-1]
        self.arealist.append(self.N)
        return self.total,self.arealist

def hightMapGenerator(text):
    height_map = []
    current_height = 0
    for letter in text:
        if letter == '\\':
            current_height -= 1
        elif letter == '/':
            current_height += 1
        else :
            pass
        height_map.append(current_height)
    return height_map

def pondChecker(text, height_map):
    # 判定
    all_ponds = []
    pond = []
    for n, letter in enumerate(text):
        if pond == []: # 池オブジェクトが空の場合
            if letter == '\\': # かつ、文字列がa の場合
                max_height = max(height_map[n:])
                if height_map[n] + 1 <= max_height: # 現在地よりも、高度の高い位置があるならば
                    start_index = n
                    pond.append(start_index) # スタート位置としてインデックスする
                else :
                    pass
        else : # 池オブジェクとにスタートが入っている場合
            if height_map[start_index] + 1 == height_map[n]: # スタートインデックスと同じ高さに来たら終わりをインデックスして、初期化
                end_index = n
                pond.append(end_index)
                all_ponds.append(pond)
                pond = []
    return all_ponds
    
def squareCalc(text, pond_height_map):
    square = 0
    current_height = max(pond_height_map)
    for n, letter in enumerate(text):
        if letter == '\\':
            square += current_height - pond_height_map[n] - 0.5
        elif letter == '/':
            square += current_height - pond_height_map[n] + 0.5
        else :
            square += current_height - pond_height_map[n]
    return int(square)

def slicedPondsGenerator(text, height_map, all_ponds):
    sliced_ponds_str = []
    sliced_height_map = []
    for pond in all_ponds:
        start = pond[0]
        end = pond[1] + 1
        sliced_pond_str = text[start:end]
        sliced_height = height_map[start:end]
        sliced_ponds_str.append(sliced_pond_str)
        sliced_height_map.append(sliced_height)
    return sliced_ponds_str, sliced_height_map

def scan_forward(F:list, S):

    depth = 0  # 深さ（開始点を基準）
    start = 0  # 「池」が始まった高さ
    is_pond = True  # 池が始まっているか？

    for s in S:
        if s == '\\':  # 下り
            if not is_pond:
                is_pond = True
                start = depth
            depth -= 1
            F.append(2*(start - depth) - 1)
            continue

        if s == "/":  # 上り
            depth += 1
            if start < depth:  # 池の開始位置より高くなった場合
                is_pond = False
                F.append(0)
                continue
            else:
                F.append(2*(start - depth) + 1)

        if s == "_":
            if is_pond:
                F.append(2*(start - depth))
            else:
                F.append(0)

def scan_backward(B:list, S):
    
    depth = 0  # 深さ（開始点を基準）
    start = 0  # 「池」が始まった高さ
    is_pond = True  # 池が始まっているか？

    for s in S:
        if s == '/':  # 下り
            if not is_pond:
                is_pond = True
                start = depth
            depth -= 1
            B.append(2*(start - depth) - 1)
            continue

        if s == "\\":  # 上り
            depth += 1
            if start < depth:  # 現在地が池の開始位置より高い場合
                is_pond = False # 「池」終了
                B.append(0)
                continue
            B.append(2*(start - depth) + 1)

        if s == "_":
            if is_pond:
                B.append(2*(start - depth))
            else:
                B.append(0)

    for i in range(len(FB)):

        if is_pond:  # 池の途中
            amount += FB[i]
            if FB[i] == 1:

        else:  # 池でなくなった場合
            if FB[i] == 0: continue
            count += 1
            is_pond = True
            amount = FB[i]
    
    return all_amount//2, count, P
